culprit_citations.quoted_text: Consolidated Schedules of Investments as of March 31, 2026 (Unaudited) and December 31, 2025

findings.detail: The E07 source count combines the March 31, 2026 schedule with the separate December 31, 2025 comparative schedule; the 660-row output is correctly scoped to the report date.

rationale: Raw source identifies two distinct Schedules of Investments, one for March 31, 2026 and one for December 31, 2025. Their distinct ending fair-value totals are $2,492.984 million at table 43 row 7 and $2,202.406 million at table 69 row 7. Thus the oracle source population of 1,199 leaks comparative-period positions into a report-date check, while the 660-row output is correctly scoped to March 31, 2026. The flag is a false alarm caused by a bad comparative-inclusive anchor, not a holdings-data omission.
